exact_source_contract: Prior source writer clock a<t; source query last L observed bytes0..t matches earlier original context raw[a-L:a]. Actual future raw[t+1] is excluded from both selector and old writer key; real target used only in scoring.
historical_side_table: NOT_TAC_NATIVE_CONSTANT_MEMORY; source past exact byte history is an external diagnostic data store
limitations: Original publisher DEV already exposed, four-byte match often guaranteed identical deterministic native key, exact-history continuation may disagree with true future, raw past side-table not included in native 4160B state, no new model training or TEST.
